output.summary: An aromatic perennial native to tropical and subtropical Asia, Australia and the western Pacific. Its strongly scented green or purple leaves grow on a hairy, many-branched plant, with purplish flowers clustered in close whorls.
output.edibilityNote: Leaves are used in Thai stir-fries and curries and Minangkabau fish dishes; the plant is also widely consumed as herbal tea.
